records.rationale: The packet contains the ClaimsPro intake record (intake.md), the status history (status_history.md) and the Snowflake extract (extract.csv). These sources agree on the claim amount ($4,480), loss state (CO), claim type (Comprehensive), channel (E-Portal) and filed date (2025-11-18). The date of loss, 2025-11-15, falls within the policy period of 2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28, so the policy was in force on that date, and there are no prior claims on the policy. The completeness check found all five Comprehensive items on file, including the repair estimate (repair_estimate.md) and one damage photo. The intake package also lists a flood warning for 2025-11-15 (weather_notice.md). No contradictions or denial indicators were found in the structured record. The document contents were not reviewed under the routing rule for complete E-Portal claims, so the adjuster should check the estimate date, the photo and the weather notice against the loss. The adjuster should also confirm that the policy covers a vehicle held as dealer stock, and account for the fourth document the record counts beyond the three listed in the intake package. The claim is routed for an adjuster's decision in ClaimsPro.
